head_commit.message:
Use Bazel-reported test log path in CI

When Bazel prints an explicit failed test log path, prefer that path for the GitHub Actions log tail. This fixes Windows jobs that use the MSVC host platform, where recomputing bazel-testlogs without the same host-platform options points at local_windows-fastbuild instead of local_windows_msvc-fastbuild.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
